title: scenario/0 - events and what they must leave
description: A scenario of a machine: the events and, after every step, the expected state, structural journal (the lines the machine wrote), a subset of the data, the queue, the open requests, the requests sent and cancelled, the outcome. A part that is not named is not compared. The runner is src/machine_run/scenario.nv.

machine.description: the Latin name of the machine the scenario runs on

start_at.description: the clock of the in-memory world in milliseconds

name.description: required for word, signal and progress; the defaults are answer, failure, timeout, start

request.description: the id of the request the event answers (agent-1)

input.description: the text of the input, or an object that is written as JSON (the fields of a word, the input of the start)

code.description: the failure code of a `failure` event (ModelRefused)

source.description: the key of the source of the event: the engine acknowledges it after the commit

data.description: the names of data and their values in the JSON form of the core

queue.description: send <id> and cancel <id> that wait for the dispatch, in <name> that wait for the pump

sent.description: all the requests sent so far

cancelled.description: all the requests cancelled so far

event.description: required for feed, accept and deliver
